name: Kearney
one_liner: Century-old, partner-owned global firm known for operations, procurement, and supply chain strength alongside strategy work.
at_a_glance: Roughly 5,300+ employees in 60+ offices across 40+ countries.
Partner-owned; bought back its independence from EDS in 2006.
Signature strengths in operations, procurement, and supply chain.

rounds: First round: ~2 interviews (~45 min) with case and fit.
Final round: ~2-3 interviews with principals/partners; MBA candidates may get a written case to present.
interview_process.case_style: Candidate-led; often operations, cost, or procurement themed. Written cases involve analyzing exhibits and presenting slides to a panel.
interview_process.fit_style: Behavioral questions in each interview, with emphasis on collaboration and a down-to-earth, client-focused style.
interview_process.assessments: Some offices use an online screening test; others skip it or use an Excel exercise.

culture: Founder quote on the 'essential rightness of the advice we give' anchors its culture.
Described as approachable and down-to-earth; 'impact first' is a stated approach.
why_us_angles: How does Kearney's operations and supply chain strength fit your operations or logistics experience?
Why does a partner-owned, mid-sized firm appeal to you versus larger firms?
Which Kearney practice or industry would you want to explore first?
prep_tips: Practice operations, cost reduction, and procurement cases.
Prepare for a written case: analyze exhibits, build a few slides, and defend them.
Use operations or supply chain stories from your work in fit answers.
Ask your recruiter whether your office uses an online test.
